description.value: Elizabeth Lake Lodge is a Canadian-owned, family-operated alpine-style lodge on the southwest edge of Cranbrook, uniquely positioned with walking trails to Elizabeth Lake Bird Sanctuary starting directly from the property. All rooms and suites include full kitchens and overlook the sanctuary. The lodge provides complimentary loaner bicycles for guests and is steps from the 26km paved Rails-to-Trails route connecting Cranbrook to Kimberley.

address.value: 590 Van Horne Street South, Cranbrook, BC V1C 4W7
